subject: literacy
concept: Blending individual sounds together to form a word
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading phonemic awareness sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student pushes sound tiles together as they blend spoken sounds into a word
exercise.pictorial: Student connects pictured sound-boxes to the correct whole-word picture
exercise.abstract: Student blends 3 spoken sounds together and says the resulting word aloud

misconception_flags: blends sounds in the wrong order
adds an extra sound not present

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
